context: This takes place just after a lively party; Gale is still buzzing with energy (he’s had some wine, but he’s not drunk) and the player has sought him out for a private, warm moment. Gale greets the player gratefully and playfully, thanking them for finding him and offering heartfelt lines. He hints that a deeper intimacy — framed as sharing a “moment of magic” — is possible, but only if their bond grows stronger; in these exchanges their relationship is still a fledgling one. Other companions may be nearby or off‑screen, and the wine is mentioned only as color — it shouldn’t affect Gale’s speech unless specified.
